> **Priority** P1/P2/P3 · **Complexity** n pts

### User story

As a <who>, I want <what>, so that <why>.

<!-- One sentence. If it needs two, it is two stories.
     Who: a visitor of the site, someone generating a skill, a
     maintainer. Naming the "who" is what stops a story from being a
     task in disguise. -->

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] 1.
- [ ] 2.
- [ ] 3.

<!-- Testable by someone who did not write them. "The wizard is clearer"
     is not a criterion; "the generated SKILL.md opens in Claude Code
     with no manual edit" is. -->

### Where it lands

<!-- Which part of the forge: the site, the generator, a skill in
     skills/, the deploy pipeline. A story touching three of them is
     three stories. -->

### Definition of Ready

- [ ] Acceptance criteria are testable by someone else
- [ ] Complexity estimated: 1 · 2 · 3 · 5 · 8 · 13
- [ ] Dependencies delivered, or explicitly stubbed
- [ ] Added to the board, in a column that means something

<!-- Complexity: 1 trivial (a string, a link) · 2 simple (a section, a
     field) · 3 standard (a page, a template) · 5 notable (custom JS, an
     external API) · 8 heavy (an algorithm, a pipeline) · 13 outside
     what we have done before. -->
